Vendored from Micro Opus (github.com/merolaagi/microopus), version in VERSION.
model.py and train.py are unchanged copies: Isomorph reads model.py to show where
weights enter the code, checks its PyTorch adapter against model.py numerically,
and calls train.py to train extra seeds. The names dataset is from karpathy/makemore
(MIT, see data/NAMES_LICENSE).
